currentTwLabel: 其他營業負債增加（減少）

zh-TW: 其他營業負債增加（減少）

note.zh-TW: 保證金依課程模板列流動負債，歸入這一列（設計說明見 T15）；減少時以負數填同一列（T12）。
note.en: Deposits received follow the course template as a current liability and belong on this line (see the design note T15); a decrease is entered as a negative on the same line (T12).

definition.zh-TW: 保證金、預收收入等營業性的其他負債增加時的加回列。應付所得稅、應付利息、借款與應付股利不能放在這裡，否則會和其他列重複計算。
definition.en: The add-back line for increases in other operating liabilities such as deposits received and contract liabilities. Current tax, interest payable, borrowings and dividends payable must not go here, or they would be double counted.
